summary: J.League Jikkyō Winning Eleven 2001 is a sports video game developed by Konami and released exclusively in Japan for the PlayStation in June 2001. It is part of the Winning Eleven J-League series and succeeds J-League Winning Eleven 2000. The game features club teams only, with 28 teams from both tiers of the J. League plus seven foreign European club teams, and it runs on the ISS Pro Evolution 2 engine.
one_line: A 2001 Konami PlayStation football game in the J-League Winning Eleven series, featuring J. League club teams and European clubs.
key_facts: J-League Jikkyō Winning Eleven 2001 is a sports video game developed by Konami.
The game was released for the PlayStation exclusively in Japan in June 2001.
The game is an addition to the Winning Eleven J-League series.
The game is the successor to J-League Winning Eleven 2000.
The game features only club teams and no national teams.
The game includes teams from both tiers of the J. League, totalling 28 teams.
The game also features seven foreign teams from European football leagues.
The game uses the ISS Pro Evolution 2 engine.
